theme: An open day — spend it on what's been waiting.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is clear straight through today, which makes it the right day to close out the travel bookings that have drifted and to get set for tomorrow's recruiter call.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is your p1, flagged as the item most likely to bite, and it's sat since mid-September. Holiday inventory out of PWM only thins from here, so a refundable hold today removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December-break trip: decide today
needsAttention.detail: The plan was decide by Sept 30, book by Oct 15 — that's tomorrow. Picking domestic versus international today (passports won't be in hand on booking day) keeps six people over three holiday weeks from losing the thinnest inventory of the year.

needsAttention.title: Recruiter call with Amin at 9:30
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow opens at 9:30 with Amin Noorani on your calendar to discuss opportunities. Worth arriving holding two or three roles or board angles you want to steer toward, plus a question or two about his pipeline.

flagged.title: Liberty Mutual payment notice
flagged.detail: A notice marked final about an outstanding bill arrived overnight. Worth confirming it's genuine before paying, since cancellation-threat mail is a common spoof.

flagged.title: Your LinkedIn post is drawing comments
flagged.detail: Sonia Trocmé-Le Page and 38 others commented on a recent post — momentum worth a glance while you're building visibility.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos — Foreign Affairs, the St. Pete and Portland dailies, Venmo's monthly statement, and a handful of retailers.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's apples are at their peak now, so a thin, burnished tart makes the most of the season's best fruit.

tasks.title: Drive the Pathfinder down (Portland → St Pete)
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: Nothing is scheduled today, so the first hours are entirely yours to point at deep work.
With the girls away this week, the afternoon stays quiet and unclaimed.
An early start waits tomorrow, so it's a night to wrap up in good time rather than push.
